tournament.name: Torneio Pauper do Weber - Tix Pro Top 8

decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with Utopia Sprawl and Wild Growth, allowing for fast deployments of powerful creatures like Annoyed Altisaur, Generous Ent, and Avenging Hunter. With cards like Malevolent Rumble and You Meet in a Tavern providing additional support, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient ramp. The inclusion of Eldrazi Repurposer and Arbor Elf adds versatility and further enhances the ability to quickly build a formidable board presence.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of cheap, aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing efficient mana sources such as Mountains and Great Furnaces, the deck is able to consistently play threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Goblin Grenade provide additional reach for closing out games, while cards like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt serve as removal options for dealing with threats. Overall, the deck aims to apply relentless pressure and win the game before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by using removal spells and creature removal, while also generating value through sacrificing creatures and tokens. The deck focuses on creating tokens with cards like Khalni Garden and Lembas, and then sacrificing them for benefits with cards like Deadly Dispute and Fanatical Offering. It also utilizes creatures like Thorn of the Black Rose and Troll of Khazad-dûm for card advantage and staying power. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can secure a win.

The deck focuses on utilizing walls to generate mana and protect its combo pieces, allowing for explosive turns using cards like Boarding Party and Generous Ent. The goal is to quickly assemble a board of walls to generate mana and cast high-impact creatures like Annoyed Altisaur and Avenging Hunter. Lead the Stampede and Winding Way help refill the hand and find key pieces, while cards like Axebane Guardian and Overgrown Battlement provide additional mana sources. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its big creatures and efficient mana generation.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly flood the board with cheap artifact creatures and then sacrifice them for value using cards like Deadly Dispute and Reckoner's Bargain. The deck aims to generate card advantage through cheap artifacts and card draw spells like Thoughtcast. Removal spells like Galvanic Blast and Cast Down help to clear the way for attacks, while cards like Kenku Artificer and Krark-Clan Shaman provide additional value and disruption. Overall, the deck focuses on efficiently utilizing artifacts and sacrificing them for maximum effect to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using low-cost and high-damage output cards such as Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Goblin Grenade. By quickly overwhelming the opponent with a continuous stream of creature and burn spells, this deck seeks to end the game before the opponent has a chance to establish a strong defense. With a strong emphasis on burn spells and efficient creatures, this deck aims to win through relentless aggression and efficient use of resources.

This deck focuses on using cheap and efficient red spells and creatures to deal damage quickly to the opponent. It utilizes cards like Lightning Bolt, Galvanic Blast, and Goblin Grenade to burn and control the opponent's creatures while deploying aggressive creatures like Goblin Bushwhacker and Goblin Blast-Runner to deliver fast damage. With a low mana curve and an emphasis on direct damage and creature aggression, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with speed and efficiency to win the game quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent through the use of low-cost, efficient creatures and spells. By using card draw and selection spells like Thought Scour, Brainstorm, and Ponder, the deck aims to consistently draw threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells. With a proactive playstyle and a focus on tempo, Mono Blue Aggro seeks to control the game early on and secure a victory before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly building up creatures with powerful auras to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive and evasive threats. By utilizing hexproof creatures like Slippery Bogle and Gladecover Scout, combined with a range of powerful auras such as Armadillo Cloak and Ancestral Mask, the deck aims to create fast, resilient threats that are difficult to deal with. The key strategy is to rapidly buff up creatures with auras to deal a large amount of damage and outpace the opponent's defenses, securing victory through a swift and overwhelming assault.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy through removal spells and card draw, while generating incremental advantages with token creatures and card advantage engines like Avenging Hunter and Thorn of the Black Rose. The deck aims to maintain board presence and outvalue the opponent by efficiently utilizing resources and maintaining a strong defensive position, ultimately overpowering the opponent with high-value threats and card advantage. The land base supports the dual-color aspect of the deck, ensuring consistent mana production for all spells.

The key concept of this deck is to use mana acceleration cards like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl to quickly ramp into heavy-hitting creatures and spells that can disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck emphasizes early aggression and tempo plays, aiming to put pressure on the opponent and maintain board presence. Cards like Mwonvuli Acid-Moss and Thermokarst can disrupt the opponent's mana base, while creatures like Annoyed Altisaur and Boarding Party provide large threats that are difficult to deal with. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and spells.

The deck focuses on putting constant pressure on the opponent with cheap and efficient creatures and burn spells. It aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total through a combination of direct damage and aggressive creature attacks. The deck utilizes artifacts to generate additional value and fuel its burn spells, while also maximizing damage output with haste and pump effects. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game and secure a swift victory through aggressive gameplay.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive red creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to use efficient creatures like Goblin Bushwhacker and Goblin Blast-Runner alongside burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning to rapidly reduce the opponent's life total. The deck also includes cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Galvanic Blast to provide additional reach and close out the game. With a low mana curve and a focus on fast, direct damage, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

The main focus of this UR Control deck is to control the game through countering opponent's spells, removal with burn spells, and generating card advantage through cantrips like Preordain and Brainstorm. The deck aims to maintain board control with removal spells like Skred and Lightning Bolt while also pressuring the opponent's life total with creatures like Murmuring Mystic and Tolarian Terror. The deck also includes some efficient creatures like Azure Fleet Admiral and Crimson Fleet Commodore to provide win conditions. Overall, the strategy revolves around strategic decision-making and resource management to outlast and outplay the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells and removal spells to prevent the opponent from developing their board and hindering their strategies. The deck also includes card draw spells to maintain card advantage and generate value. Additionally, there are creatures with abilities that provide additional advantages and threats to the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and eventually close it out with powerful spells and creatures.

This deck focuses on flooding the board with inexpensive creatures and using spells to enhance their abilities and protect them. The key strategy involves overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of weenie white creatures, while maintaining card advantage and disrupting the opponent's game plan with removal spells. The deck aims to quickly establish a dominant board presence and apply pressure early on to secure a quick victory.
